description: Change facts that belong to the WHOLE document rather than to one page: its title, its frame shape, where content sits in each frame, and which palette it is designed in. Omitted fields are left alone. Frame shape and content position live here, not on set_page, because a document is one shape and keeps one rhythm.

align.description: Where blocks sit in the leftover vertical space on EVERY page: top, middle or bottom. Defaults to middle.

animate.description: How blocks enter a page: none, fade, rise or grow. Defaults to none; set_page may override a page.

build.description: arrive shows every block with the page; click reveals one block per keypress. Defaults to arrive.

format.description: Frame shape for every page. Defaults to 16:9. A4 is a portrait sheet.

mode.description: Which palette the document is designed in: light or dark. A page may override it.

pace.description: How fast blocks and words enter: slow, medium or fast. Defaults to medium.

title.description: The document's name. Not a heading on any page.

transition.description: How pages change while presenting: slide, fade, zoom or none. Defaults to slide.

name: set_document
title: Set the document's title, shape or palette
